permissionLabels.api.keys: Create API keys for BI tools

systemReports.title: Revenue by service line
systemReports.description: Gross, discount, net and collected revenue for each service line.

systemReports.title: Daily revenue and collections
systemReports.description: Net revenue and collections for each day in the period.

systemReports.title: Monthly revenue trend
systemReports.description: Month-by-month net revenue, discounts and collections.

systemReports.title: Revenue transaction detail
systemReports.description: Row-level billed revenue. Long periods run in the background and are delivered as a file.

systemReports.title: Payer mix
systemReports.description: Share of net revenue by payer type.

systemReports.title: Claims and denials by payer
systemReports.description: Submitted, approved and denied claims with denial rate and value.

systemReports.title: Denial reasons
systemReports.description: Denied claims and value by main denial reason.

systemReports.title: Receivables aging
systemReports.description: Outstanding approved claim value by aging bucket.

systemReports.title: Trial balance
systemReports.description: Debit and credit movements by account for the period, with net balance. Totals should reconcile to zero.

systemReports.title: General ledger detail
systemReports.description: Posted journal lines. Long periods run in the background.

systemReports.title: Income and expense summary
systemReports.description: Net income and expense by account, the basis of a profit and loss view.

systemReports.title: Expense by cost center
systemReports.description: Expense postings by cost center.

systemReports.title: Appointment attendance
systemReports.description: Booked, attended, cancelled and no-show appointments by department.

systemReports.title: No-show trend
systemReports.description: Monthly no-show rate.

systemReports.title: Waiting time by department
systemReports.description: Average patient waiting time.

systemReports.title: Clinical activity by department
systemReports.description: OP visits, ED visits, admissions and discharges.

systemReports.title: Bed occupancy trend
systemReports.description: Monthly occupied and available bed-days with occupancy rate.

systemReports.title: Admissions register
systemReports.description: Patient-level admissions. Patient identifiers are masked unless your role may see them.

systemReports.title: Length of stay by department
systemReports.description: Admissions, average length of stay and average bill.

systemReports.title: Diagnostics turnaround
systemReports.description: Orders, completion and average turnaround time by test group.

systemReports.title: Diagnostics volume trend
systemReports.description: Monthly diagnostic orders.

systemReports.title: Stock position
systemReports.description: Receipts, issues and closing value by store and category. Use a single day for closing figures.

systemReports.title: Near-expiry stock
systemReports.description: Value of stock expiring within 30 days, by branch and category.

systemReports.title: 30-day readmissions
systemReports.description: Readmission count and rate by department.

systemReports.title: Discharge outcomes
systemReports.description: Admissions by discharge status.

systemReports.title: Budget versus actual
systemReports.description: Target and actual net revenue by service line with variance.

systemReports.title: Forecast scenarios
systemReports.description: Monthly scenario targets alongside actuals, including future months.

systemReports.title: Service line growth
systemReports.description: Yearly net revenue across ten years.

roles.name: Administrator
roles.description: Full access to every report, setting and user.

roles.name: Finance manager
roles.description: Owns revenue, revenue cycle, accounting and planning reports.

roles.name: Accountant
roles.description: Ledger, trial balance and revenue reporting.

roles.name: Clinical manager
roles.description: Clinical, quality and diagnostics reporting including patient-level data.

roles.name: Analyst
roles.description: Builds and exports reports; no patient identifiers.

dashboards.name: Executive overview
dashboards.description: Headline revenue, collections, capacity and access measures.

dashboards.name: Finance daily
dashboards.description: Cash, claims and receivables for the finance team.

sources.name: Demo clinical and financial warehouse
sources.description: Synthetic, deterministic data for ten years across four branches. Not real business data.

sources.name: Hospital system read replica (PostgreSQL)
sources.description: Read-only replica of the hospital management system. Reports must never query the live primary.

sources.name: ERP ledger (SQL Server)
sources.description: Posted journals and financial periods for trial balance and statements.

sources.name: Laboratory system API (REST)
sources.description: Allow-listed HTTPS endpoint with server-side token and row limits.

sources.name: Analytics warehouse (ClickHouse / Snowflake)
sources.description: Column store for multi-year aggregates as volume grows.
